The Shop

Built on Craft.
Kept by Regulars.

Wood's Barber Shop is a New Orleans original — the kind of place where the barber knows your name and your cut before you sit down. No gimmicks, no waiting room TVs blaring. Just sharp scissors, a steady hand, and a straight razor when you need one.

This is a neighborhood shop. The regulars built it, and the craft keeps them coming back. Walk-ins welcome. Loyalty appreciated.

  • Hot lather straight-razor shaves
  • Fades, tapers & classic cuts
  • Walk-ins always welcome
  • Serving New Orleans with no-nonsense barbering
